title: Semantic Binding, World Sync & Discovery/Fog Projection
objective: Implement explicit map-element bindings and proposals to governed owner records, owner-version/staleness handling, refresh/rebase and map-only overrides, typed owner routing, and party/campaign discovery projections that filter hidden truth before rendering without creating a parallel owner ledger.

scope.purpose: Provide the semantic binding, owner-version sync and discovery/fog projection adapter layer between MCS map elements and governed owner domains while preserving owner authority and authorization-before-projection.
included: explicit bindings and proposals for locations, regions, settlements, routes, environments, territories, scenes, portals and discoveries
scope.completion_gate: Representative MCS documents can deterministically bind or propose map elements to typed owner records, detect stale owner versions, refresh/rebase or retain map-only overrides, and render party/campaign discovery projections only after hidden truth is filtered, without mutating owner truth or creating a parallel canonical ledger.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.3.0 were reconsulted after MCS-15 exact-tree publication. No cross-program rotation detour supersedes the surviving MCS strict order, so MCS-18 is selected.
MCS-18 owns the map-side semantic binding, owner-version sync and discovery/fog projection adapter seam; owner domains remain canonical.
Bindings and proposals must be explicit and typed. Drawn adjacency, labels, geometry or visual similarity do not infer canonical owner relationships.
Owner-version references, stale detection, refresh/rebase and map-only overrides must preserve owner truth and expose divergence rather than silently overwriting it.
Party/campaign discovery projections must filter hidden truth before rendering and may not grant permissions or disclose protected existence.

MCS-18 is governed-started on branch work/mcs-18-semantic-binding-world-sync-discovery from application main bb56df55cfe28f57e794709d807d238d8d2442a8; implementation authority is limited to this bounded tranche.
MCS-19, PCA-16, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, MNCS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized by this selection.
next_action: Establish causal RED for explicit typed owner binding, staleness/rebase and filtered discovery projection, then implement only the bounded MCS-18 adapter behavior and continue through validation, publication and closeout.
